mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% triggers an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index signals an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 4.5% and the consumer price index is above 200 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when payroll employment is below 138000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate, housing starts, and retail sales signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth, housing starts, and retail sales (t-test p > 0.05).
